references.text: Introduces Terah and his sons Abram, Nahor, and Haran, and tells that Haran died in Ur of the Chaldeans – the direct background for the family's journey in verse 31.
God's call to Abram to leave his land and his kindred for the land God would show him, continuing the journey that began in 11:31.
God reminds Abram that He brought him out from Ur of the Chaldeans, a direct reference to the starting point of Terah's journey with the family.
Nehemiah confesses that God chose Abram, brought him out from Ur of the Chaldeans, and gave him the name Abraham.
Stephen tells that the God of glory appeared to Abraham while he was in Mesopotamia, before he settled in Haran, and that after his father's death he went to the land of Canaan.
Completion of the journey from Haran to Canaan: 11:31 shows the start and interruption, while 12:5 shows the final fulfillment of God's call.
